direction: Clock Buddy: playful, warm, character-led. Background: off-white #FEFDFD, with two layered flat rounded ground shapes at the bottom of the canvas: a back hill in pale lavender #E6DEFF and a front hill in pale sky blue #D6E8FF, flat, no texture. Character: Buddy, a small friendly round alarm clock mascot made from the app icon: a round clock body with two small bells on top (left bell violet #6C38FC, right bell cyan #02CEF0), the body filled with a smooth gradient from violet #6C38FC to blue #0A7AFD to cyan #02CEF0, a white round face, two simple dark navy #0B1020 dot eyes and a happy mouth drawn as five tiny rounded waveform bars, two stubby rounded arms, two tiny feet, flat vector style with no outlines and no texture, about 20% of the canvas height. Typography: a heavy rounded geometric sans (Manrope ExtraBold style), sentence case, tight leading, headline color navy #0B1020, accent word in violet #6C38FC. Subheadline in #4A5170, regular weight. Device: iPad Pro 13-inch in portrait, silver aluminum frame, thin uniform bezels, soft shadow.

layouts.cw: Layout (iPad 3:4 canvas): headline block in the top 22% of the canvas (top 5% free of text), left-aligned at a 6% margin, headline letters about 6% of the canvas height tall, subheadline directly below; below the text the iPad in portrait, tilted about 6 degrees clockwise, large (about 72% of the canvas width), its lower right corner running off the right edge and bottom of the canvas, standing on the ground hills; Buddy stands on the ground in the lower left corner in front of the iPad's bottom left edge, about 20% of the canvas height, never covering any UI text.
